title: sdr daily scratchpad - Marcus Allen - 2026-03-11
body:
Morning plan / goals:
- 3 qualified conversations today (target)
- 12 dials / 30 total outreach touches (calls + voicemails + follow-up emails)
- Move 2 opps to demo stage, 1 to disqualified

Time blocks:
- 09:00-10:30 outbound calls (top accounts)
- 10:30-11:00 follow-up emails + LinkedIn connect
- 11:00-12:00 prospecting / CRM cleanup
- 14:00-15:30 demos / discovery calls (if booked)
- 16:00-17:00 pipeline review + notes/logging

Priority accounts / call list (AM focus):
1) Nimbus Health - Sarah Cho (Dir Product) - inbound interest from webinar. Note: asked about HIPAA/private deployment. Objectives: qualify data sensitivity, security reqs, timeline. Ask about trials and decision makers. Next: send HIPAA one-pager + schedule discovery.
2) ArcStream - Ben Ortiz (CTO) - cold out of warm intro (Avery). Ben cares about latency/cost. If >2k reqs/day ask about Dedicated. Send benchmark summary + request for traffic pattern.
3) Helix Retail - Priya Menon (Head of ML) - follow-up from last week demo. They asked about model version pinning and rollouts. Need internal decision timeline. Push for demo with infra lead.
4) Satori Analytics - Daniel Park (VP Eng) - pricing objection last time. Prepare cost comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated) and Redwood Optimize bullets.
5) BlueLine Logistics - Emily Grant (Ops) - voicemail left 03/09. Low-touch nurture (waitlist).

Quick notes / snippets to paste in emails:
- "We can pin model versions + set canary rollouts so you can validate quality without downtime. Happy to show this in a 20m demo."
- "Typical customers see 20-40% per-token cost reduction after enabling KV caching + batching--I can share a tailored config for your workload."

Follow-ups / action items (by EOD):
- Send HIPAA one-pager + scheduling link to Sarah (Nimbus) - ACTION: attach security one-pager from Confluence page CONFLUENCE-1221.
- Create cost comparison deck for Satori (CRM-872) - include Dedicated commit examples.
- Log all call notes in CRM and tag with source=webinar / source=intro.
- Add ArcStream to next week's cadence (3-touch sequence) and assign to sequence "mid-market-warm".

Pipeline notes (quick):
- Nimbus Health: MQL -> Demo requested. Prob: 65%. Key people: Sarah + security lead. Timeline: Q2 pilot.
- ArcStream: Outbound -> Discovery. Prob: 40%. Main pain: per-request latency and cost variability.
- Helix Retail: Demo done. Waiting on infra availability. Prob: 55%.

Objections & rebuttals (short):
- "We host models ourselves": acknowledge, ask about ops cost + SLAs, highlight rollout and cost controls.
- "Too expensive": ask about current unit costs, offer Optimize recommendations and a short pilot to measure savings.

Email templates (short):
- Follow-up after voicemail:
  Subject: Quick follow-up + one-pager
  Hi {name},
  Left a voicemail earlier--wanted to send a quick one-pager on how Redwood handles private deployments and HIPAA-compliant inference. Can we book 20m next week to run through security & pilot options?
  Cheers,
  Marcus

- Post-demo next steps:
  Subject: Next steps + sample config
  Hi {name},
  Thanks for your time today. As promised, attaching a short sample config and cost comparison for the workload we reviewed. I'll follow up next Tues to see if you'd like to run a pilot.

Notes to self / misc:
- Remember to mention model pinning + automatic fallback (important for Helix).
- Check with Solutions Eng (Maya) about Dedicated autoscale burst limits before ArcStream call (Slack thread above).
- Update demo deck (slide 6) with latest latency numbers (ask eng/observability).

CRM logging checklist (quick):
- Update lead source, add meeting links, attach HIPAA one-pager, set next_touch date.

End-of-day metrics to capture:
- calls made / dials, meetings booked, demos run, stage changes in pipeline.

Unresolved questions:
- Nimbus: do they need on-prem or VPC? Confirm with Sarah during discovery.
- Helix: who is infra lead? ask Priya for intro.

Notes from yesterday (copy):
- Demo with Helix: they like rollouts; some concern about token costs for long contexts. Suggested quantization + caching tests.

Random TODOs:
- Pull updated cost example from marketing (linked_artifacts above).
- Sync with Maya for tech Qs after 1pm.

— end scratchpad —

(quick, messy, meant for logging and copy/paste into CRM/email templates)
